notes.content: Some labels were not changing appropriately when switching Simplified Chinese. They are now working!

notes.title: Simple update
notes.content: Simply changed a few cat names. Also, Hi! :D

notes.title: Hotfix #2
notes.content: - Fixed a hint that did not redirect to the right cat.

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.content:
- Synchronized the cat name notifications to when you click them so the cat's name you see is the one you clicked. Some people were just too good at the game and clicked the cats so fast, there would be a queue and names would become desynchronized.

- Added a description of how hints work in timed mode. The hints become not random anymore when you play timed mode to allow people to make consistent routes when planning.

notes.title: New languages and fixed a lighting issue
notes.content:
Added 2 new languages: Spanish and German.

Also fixed lighting issue that happened on some versions of the game that made some walls "glitch" visually.
